Comparison summary (fixed usage basis)

  • Estimated monthly cost: GLM-5.3-Flash ¥10.49 vs Qwen3.8-Flash ¥10.02 on a common CNY basis (list prices ¥10.49 / ¥10.02) — at this fixed usage, Qwen3.8-Flash is cheaper by ¥0.47/month.
  • Cost ratio: under this basis, GLM-5.3-Flash costs about 1.0× Qwen3.8-Flash (Qwen3.8-Flash is ~5% cheaper). The ratio holds only at the current list prices, reference rate and fixed usage assumptions; it says nothing about capability, output quality or overall value.
  • Input unit price (off-peak / single-price basis) tied after conversion: both ≈ ¥0.80 (list prices ¥0.8 / ¥0.8).
  • Output unit price (off-peak / single-price basis): list prices ¥2.8 vs ¥2.7; after conversion Qwen3.8-Flash is lower (by ≈ ¥0.1/1M tokens).
  • Cache-hit price (off-peak basis): GLM-5.3-Flash ¥0.23; Qwen3.8-Flash ¥0.1.
  • Context window: GLM-5.3-Flash 1024K vs Qwen3.8-Flash 1000K — GLM-5.3-Flash is 1.0× Qwen3.8-Flash.
  • Modalities: identical — Text, Image understanding, Video understanding.
  • Price sources: Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — GLM-5.3-Flash model page (verified 2026-10-28), Alibaba Cloud Model Studio — Qwen3.8-Flash model page (verified 2026-10-28); unit: official list price per 1M tokens (GLM-5.3-Flash in CNY, Qwen3.8-Flash in CNY).

These are computations from published list prices under fixed call volume, token usage, cache assumptions and billing rules. They are not rankings of capability, output quality or overall value, and do not constitute purchase advice.
